purpose: Bounded instrument functional rehearsal; not a product performance budget or baseline

analyzer.compatibility: Local Linux execution observed; no portable manylinux floor qualified

instrument.host_class: managed Linux x86_64; shared host, unrelated occupancy not inventoried

sanitization: Absolute executable paths and PIDs removed; raw memory samples unchanged. Full raw operation documents are represented by SHA-256 witnesses and semantic equality summaries, not copied here.

runs.cache_regime: fresh private disk cache per surface; reused by resident and references; new reference process per operation
runs.concurrency: one resident subject; one fresh reference after each resident sample window; unrelated host work is not inventoried
runs.cpu: not measured; elapsed wall time is not CPU
runs.instrument: sampled Linux /proc/PID/status VmRSS; direct server only; bytes
limitations: Not heap or aggregate descendant memory
Sampled peaks may miss between-sample peaks
Fresh reference processes warm the shared disk cache between operations
Fixed small workload does not establish large-workspace budgets
Transport teardown/reopen is exercised; request cancellation and interrupted refresh supersession are not established

owned_cleanup_control.scope: synthetic same-group grandchild inheriting stdin/stdout; terminal means absent or zombie, not descendant reaping; no escaped-descendant claim

retained_state_negative_control.scope: separate synthetic measured child, not RIPR

surfaces.cleanup: owned process group signaled and primary reaped; no escaped-descendant claim
